claim: Answer / personal section / FAQ: Garmin's Personal API is available for personal use.
quote: The Garmin Connect Personal API is available for personal use and is the quickest way to gain access to your data for use in personal applications.

claim: Personal section: not intended for commercial applications serving multiple end users.
quote: It is not intended for commercial applications serving multiple end users.

claim: Personal section / FAQ: you create the key on Garmin Connect Web.
quote: Go to the Personal API Key page while logged in to your Garmin Connect Web account

claim: Personal section: until October 2026 the FAQ said the program was only for business use (Wayback Machine capture of October 17, 2026).
quote: There are no licensing or maintenance fees for access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program, but it is only for business use.

claim: Personal section: garminconnect authenticates with the same mobile SSO flow as Garmin's mobile apps.
quote: Authentication uses the same mobile SSO flow as the official Garmin Connect mobile apps.

claim: Why teams look / FAQ: the FAQ now describes Starter Access.
quote: Starter Access: Developers can gain immediate access and launch with Garmin, with access to core data and tools.

claim: Why teams look / FAQ: and Enterprise Access.
quote: Enterprise Access: For companies operating at scale, this new model aligns with growth, offering expanded data access, reliability, and enterprise-grade support.

claim: Why teams look / FAQ: once your request is approved you get the Garmin Developer Portal.
quote: After you request access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program and your request has been approved, you will be granted access to the Garmin Developer Portal and can get started on your integration right away.

claim: Why teams look: Enterprise commercial terms are tailored.
quote: Designed for companies operating at scale requiring capabilities beyond Starter Access. Available options and commercial terms are tailored based on business and technical requirements.

claim: Oura limits an application to 10 users before approval.
quote: By default, API Applications have a ten user limit. If you want to release your application to a wider audience, your application needs to be approved.

claim: There is no limit once approved.
quote: There is no limit once an application is approved.

claim: New WHOOP apps start on a Sandbox tier of 10 members.
quote: Every new app starts on the Sandbox tier, which allows up to 10 WHOOP members to connect.
